title: Smoke Detector Beep
blurb: The smoke detector low-battery chirp — a single high beep, followed by silence, followed by madness. It's the most psychologically devastating sound in any home: impossible to locate, impossible to ignore, arriving exactly once every 43 seconds at 3am. As a prank it's a war crime. Play it near anyone and watch them lose their mind hunting a detector that doesn't exist.
origin: The universal low-battery chirp of smoke detectors everywhere.
